title: Add adaptive async experiment progress policy
description: Teaches agents to declare heartbeat monitoring policy for local async experiments, including time milestones, log milestones, quiet alerts, and adaptive intervals.
changes: Define how agents should choose time milestones, log milestones, quiet alerts, and interval bounds.
Clarify that running progress is shown in the Process panel and should not trigger a standalone user-facing reply.
Preserve the no busy-polling rule and completion/failed notification behavior.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous unversioned async execution guidance if adaptive progress policy causes undesirable agent behavior.
